# IPluginTrigger

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · interface

```csharp
public interface IPluginTrigger
```

A trigger source: runs while the plugin is loaded and raises events with [`ITriggerSink.Raise`](ITriggerSink.md#raise). Automations react to them through the trigger types the class declares.

Put one [`PluginComponentAttribute`](PluginComponentAttribute.md) on the class for every event it raises, for example `acme.usb.connected` and `acme.usb.disconnected`. Each becomes a trigger users can pick. The [`FieldAttribute`](FieldAttribute.md)s of the class apply to all of them.

## Methods

### RunAsync

```csharp
Task RunAsync(ITriggerSink sink, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
```

Watches for events until `cancellationToken` is cancelled. Do not return early: when this method ends, the trigger stops.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `sink` | Raises events. |
| `cancellationToken` | Cancelled when the plugin stops. |
